## Overview

This is a legacy script from the earlier all-site analysis (primary tumours plus metastatic biopsies from bone, lymph node and soft tissue). It is included for transparency and is not part of the bone-only pipeline. It ran SpatialDecon with the generic safeTME immune and stromal reference on all QC-passed, non-control AOIs at every timepoint. The aims were to check the segmentation masks (CD45⁺ immune-dominant, tumour segments tumour-dominant) and to describe CD45⁺ immune composition by response group and timepoint. No per-probe negative-control matrix was available, so each AOI's negative-probe geometric mean was used as a uniform background. Counts were Q3-normalised. Tumour AOIs with ESTIMATE purity above 0.9 served as anchors, from which SpatialDecon estimated tumour profiles.

No output of this script is used in the current analysis. The manuscript's deconvolution uses tissue-matched references (PCCAT; GSE143791 plus PCCAT tumour profiles) in comp_03b, comp_17 and comp_19. phase6b corrects how the proportions were computed here.

**Manuscript items supported**

- Not used by the manuscript (legacy; superseded by the tissue-matched deconvolution of comp_03b/comp_17/comp_19)

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --legacy` (optional; not needed to reproduce the manuscript, whose frozen inputs are in `data/previous_analysis/`). Approximate runtime: a few minutes.

**Depends on**: `comp_00a`

## Analysis

### Legacy SpatialDecon run

The header gives the scope, the background approximation and the normalisation.

Selects QC-passed, non-control AOIs with a background estimate. The script Q3-normalises the counts, builds a uniform per-AOI background matrix, marks high-purity tumour AOIs as anchors, and runs `spatialdecon` with safeTME and its cell-type merges. The result object is saved.

```{r phase6-spatialdecon-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE Trial GeoMx DSP -- Phase 6: SpatialDecon (safeTME) cell-type deconvolution
##
## Runs across all QC-passed, non-Control AOIs (Archival/Screening/Cycle1/
## DiseaseProgression, all 3 segments) to (a) validate segment masks (CD45+
## should be immune-dominant, PSMA+/PanCK+PSMA- tumour-dominant) and (b)
## characterise immune-cell composition within CD45+ specifically by response
## group and timepoint.
##
## Background: no per-probe negative-control matrix is available (stripped
## from the main SE -- see Phase 1/2 notes), so the validated per-AOI
## negative-probe geometric mean already reconstructed in Phase 2
## (colData$neg_probe_geomean) is used as a uniform per-AOI background level,
## a standard simplification when per-probe background isn't available.
## Normalization: upper-quartile (Q3), the standard approach for GeoMx counts
## ahead of spatialdecon.
## ============================================================================

suppressMessages({
  library(qs); library(SummarizedExperiment); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
  library(SpatialDecon); library(ggplot2)
})

PRINCE_ROOT <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."))
RAW_DIR <- file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "data", "interim")     # all-site QC'd objects written by comp_00a_qc
dir.create(file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "results_legacy"), showWarnings = FALSE)
setwd(file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "results_legacy"))           # legacy outputs; frozen copies used downstream are in data/previous_analysis
dir.create("Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

se <- qs::qread(file.path(RAW_DIR, "phase2_se_with_qc_metrics.qs"))
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
idx <- cd$qc_status == "PASS" & cd$response_group_neat != "Control" & !is.na(cd$neg_probe_geomean)
se <- se[, idx]
cd <- droplevels(as.data.frame(colData(se)))
cat("N AOIs for deconvolution:", ncol(se), "\n")

raw <- assay(se, "all_count")
raw <- as.matrix(raw)

## Q3 (upper-quartile) normalization -- standard for GeoMx ahead of spatialdecon
q3 <- apply(raw, 2, function(x) quantile(x[x > 0], 0.75))
norm <- sweep(raw, 2, q3, "/") * mean(q3)

## background: uniform per-AOI negative-probe geomean (validated in Phase 2)
bg <- matrix(rep(cd$neg_probe_geomean, each = nrow(raw)), nrow = nrow(raw),
             dimnames = dimnames(raw))

## mark high-purity PSMA+/PanCK+ AOIs as pure-tumour anchors so spatialdecon
## can estimate an empirical tumour profile (safeTME itself has no tumour
## reference, by design)
is_pure_tumor <- cd$segment_name %in% c("PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA-") & cd$tumour.purity.estimate > 0.9
cat("N AOIs marked as pure-tumour anchors:", sum(is_pure_tumor), "\n")

data("safeTME")
data("safeTME.matches")

cat("\nRunning spatialdecon (this may take a few minutes)...\n")
res <- spatialdecon(norm = norm, bg = bg, X = safeTME, raw = raw,
                     is_pure_tumor = is_pure_tumor, cellmerges = safeTME.matches)

saveRDS(res, "phase6_spatialdecon_results.rds")
cat("Saved raw spatialdecon result object.\n")

```

### Mask validation

Sums the non-tumour proportions per AOI and summarises them by compartment. A boxplot is saved.

```{r phase6-spatialdecon-02}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 1: Mask validation -- non-tumour (immune+stroma) fraction by segment
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
prop_all <- res$prop_of_all  # cell types x AOIs, proportions including tumour cluster
cell_types <- rownames(prop_all)
immune_types <- setdiff(cell_types, c("tumor", grep("^tumor", cell_types, value = TRUE)))
cat("\nCell type rows returned:", paste(cell_types, collapse = ", "), "\n")

nontumor_frac <- colSums(prop_all[rownames(prop_all) != "tumor", , drop = FALSE])
cd$nontumor_fraction <- nontumor_frac[colnames(se)]

cat("\n================ MASK VALIDATION: non-tumour fraction by segment ================\n")
print(cd %>% group_by(segment_name) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), median_nontumor = median(nontumor_fraction),
                  mean_nontumor = mean(nontumor_fraction)))

p_mask <- ggplot(cd, aes(segment_name, nontumor_fraction, fill = segment_name)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) + theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "SpatialDecon mask validation", subtitle = "Non-tumour (immune+stromal) fraction by segment",
       x = NULL, y = "Non-tumour fraction") + theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave("Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/mask_validation.pdf", p_mask, width = 6, height = 5)

```

### CD45⁺ composition

Within CD45⁺ AOIs, the script tests each cell-type proportion of the non-tumour compartment against response group (archival and pre-treatment AOIs) and against timepoint. These are AOI-level linear models without patient blocking. It also prints macrophage fractions by response and timepoint and saves a stacked composition plot.

```{r phase6-spatialdecon-03}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 2: Within CD45+, per-celltype proportions (of non-tumour compartment)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cd45_idx <- which(cd$segment_name == "CD45+")
prop_nontumor <- res$prop_of_nontumor  # already renormalised excluding tumour cluster
celltype_mat <- t(prop_nontumor[, colnames(se)[cd45_idx], drop = FALSE])
celltype_df <- as.data.frame(celltype_mat)
celltype_df$subject_id <- cd$subject_id[cd45_idx]
celltype_df$timepoint <- cd$timepoint[cd45_idx]
celltype_df$response_group_neat <- cd$response_group_neat[cd45_idx]

write.csv(celltype_df, "Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_celltype_proportions.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n================ CD45+ CELL TYPE COMPOSITION: mean proportion overall ================\n")
mean_props <- sort(colMeans(celltype_mat), decreasing = TRUE)
print(round(mean_props, 4))

## Test each cell type for response-group association, within Archival+Screening (baseline)
cat("\n================ CD45+ CELL TYPE vs RESPONSE GROUP (Archival+Screening) ================\n")
sub <- celltype_df %>% filter(timepoint %in% c("Archival", "Screening"))
test_rows <- list()
for (ct in colnames(celltype_mat)) {
  fit <- lm(sub[[ct]] ~ sub$response_group_neat)
  pval <- tryCatch(anova(fit)$`Pr(>F)`[1], error = function(e) NA)
  r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
  means <- tapply(sub[[ct]], sub$response_group_neat, mean)
  test_rows[[ct]] <- data.frame(celltype = ct, R2 = r2, pval = pval,
                                 mean_Intermediate = means["Intermediate"],
                                 mean_NonResponder = means["Non_Responder"],
                                 mean_Responder = means["Responder"])
}
test_tab <- bind_rows(test_rows) %>% arrange(pval)
print(test_tab, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(test_tab, "Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_celltype_vs_response.csv", row.names = FALSE)

## Test each cell type across timepoints (pooled response groups) -- does
## composition change over the treatment course?
cat("\n================ CD45+ CELL TYPE vs TIMEPOINT (all patients) ================\n")
test_rows_tp <- list()
for (ct in colnames(celltype_mat)) {
  fit <- lm(celltype_df[[ct]] ~ celltype_df$timepoint)
  pval <- tryCatch(anova(fit)$`Pr(>F)`[1], error = function(e) NA)
  means <- tapply(celltype_df[[ct]], celltype_df$timepoint, mean)
  test_rows_tp[[ct]] <- data.frame(celltype = ct, pval = pval,
                                    Archival = means["Archival"], Screening = means["Screening"],
                                    Cycle1 = means["Cycle1"], DiseaseProgression = means["DiseaseProgression"])
}
test_tab_tp <- bind_rows(test_rows_tp) %>% arrange(pval)
print(test_tab_tp, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(test_tab_tp, "Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_celltype_vs_timepoint.csv", row.names = FALSE)

## Macrophage fraction specifically (bone-niche / osteoclast hypothesis check)
cat("\n================ MACROPHAGE FRACTION: response x timepoint ================\n")
print(celltype_df %>% group_by(timepoint, response_group_neat) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), mean_macrophage = mean(macrophages), .groups = "drop"))

## stacked composition plot
long <- celltype_df %>% pivot_longer(-c(subject_id, timepoint, response_group_neat),
                                      names_to = "celltype", values_to = "prop")
top_types <- names(sort(colMeans(celltype_mat), decreasing = TRUE))[1:8]
long$celltype_grp <- ifelse(long$celltype %in% top_types, long$celltype, "other")
p_stack <- ggplot(long %>% filter(timepoint %in% c("Archival","Screening","Cycle1")),
                   aes(x = response_group_neat, y = prop, fill = celltype_grp)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~timepoint) + theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "CD45+ estimated immune composition (mean proportion of non-tumour)", x = NULL, y = "Mean proportion", fill = "Cell type") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
ggsave("Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_composition_stacked.pdf", p_stack, width = 10, height = 6)

cat("\nSaved all Phase 6 outputs under Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/\n")
cat("Phase 6 script complete.\n")
```
